credential_helper = git(
        "config",
        "--local",
        "--get",
        "credential.helper",
        cwd=ROOT,
        check=False,
    ).stdout.strip()
    if not credential_helper:
        return False, "development_push_credentials_missing"

    push = run(
        [
            "git",
            "-c",
            f"credential.helper={credential_helper}",
            "-c",
            "credential.useHttpPath=true",
            "push",
            REMOTE,
            f"{head}:refs/heads/{DEV_BRANCH}",
        ],
        cwd=ROOT,
        env_extra={"EDARSA_ALLOW_PUSH": "1"},
    )
    if push.returncode != 0:
        return False, f"development_push_failed:{push.stdout[-1000:]}"

from pathlib import Path


def test_dispatcher_push_uses_local_credential_helper_fail_closed():
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    text = (root / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_dispatcher.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'credential.helper' in text
    assert 'credential.useHttpPath=true' in text
    assert 'development_push_credentials_missing' in text
    assert '/usr/bin/gh' not in text
    assert 'gh auth git-credential' not in text
